---
title: "Services"
---

Each service below is described twice: once in plain terms, and once in the terms a psychometrician or analyst would use.

## Assessment & Psychometrics

*For education agencies, credentialing and licensing bodies, and research teams that run or rely on a test.*

[In plain terms]{.rds-kicker}
I check whether a test measures what it claims to, whether it scores people fairly, and whether a score means the same thing from one form to the next. You get the analysis and the documentation you need to defend it.

[In technical terms]{.rds-kicker}
Item and form analysis, DIF/fairness analyses, equating, linking, and scaling, standard setting support, validity and reliability evidence, technical reports, and assessment program review.

## R, Shiny, & Reproducible Tools

*For teams that rerun the same analysis or rebuild the same report by hand.*

[In plain terms]{.rds-kicker}
I build the software around an analysis, so it runs the same way every time and people who do not write code can use it. That might be a web app, an automated report, or an R package, and it replaces fragile spreadsheet workflows.

[In technical terms]{.rds-kicker}
Shiny dashboards and decision-support apps, Quarto reports and reproducible reporting pipelines, R package development, deployment, and support, workflow automation, and code review and refactoring.

## Operations & Planning Models

*For direct care practices and other new or small service-based businesses.*

[In plain terms]{.rds-kicker}
I build models that answer money questions: when you will break even, what happens if membership grows more slowly than planned, and how much the owner can take home.

[In technical terms]{.rds-kicker}
Break-even modeling, capacity planning, pricing scenarios, service-line planning, forecasting and sensitivity analysis, and interactive planning tools.

If you run a direct care practice, this work already exists as a product at [Direct Care Analytics](https://directcareanalytics.com).
